newsitem.title: ESTONIA: FOREKS MAY REVISE FORECAST AFTER H1.
newsitem.headline: FOREKS MAY REVISE FORECAST AFTER H1.

text.p: Forekspank is not going to revise its 1997 profit forecast after the end of the first quarter but might do it based on half-year figures, finance director Raivo Erik said on Thursday.
The first quarter results were better than predicted but Forekspank doubts the favourable situation in the stock and credit market will continue, Erik told Reuters.
Forekspank earlier said it netted a profit of 28.99 million kroons during the first quarter, more than 40 percent of its 72 million kroons estimate for the whole year.
"We do not think that the the favourable situation will continue," Erik told Reuters.
"The share market has gone up but will come down one day and we don't know how well we will succeed in earning from the falling market," he added.
He also mentioned new, stricter capital adequacy requirements coming into force in October as a factor that will affect banks' profit figures.
